why: release 119: main after 117 was 726,303 bytes. feat-preview-checkboxes adds a task box in the editor's preview that toggles its source line (59-md.js data-line and taskToggle, 60-preview.js taskFlip, about 3.2 KB). fix-editor-cursor adds the vim block cursor (27-vim.js, 4,700 bytes) and hlSplice, which writes each edit straight into the highlight overlay so the caret no longer drifts on long pages (25-editor.js, 2,100 bytes). The preview, the editor and vim are all on screen from boot, so none can load lazily.
